title: Private networking
intro: Communicate with this service from within the network

statusHint.pending: It was deployed before its current names. The next deploy gives them to it.
statusHint.offline: Its names answer again once it is running.
statusHint.taken: {service} already answers to this name, so this service is deployed without it. Give one of them another name.
statusHint.kept: It keeps previous deployments running, so each is reached by its own address and these names are not given out. Turn off Keep previous deployments to use them.
statusHint.unsupported: This server's Polaris predates private names. Update it from <link>Settings</link> to turn them on.

shortName: You can also simply call me {name}
renameHint: The old name keeps answering for {days} days, so services deployed with it go on working.
renamed: Renamed. It is being redeployed so the new name answers.
renamedNext: Renamed. It takes the new name on its next deploy, so its connections are not cut now.
renamedLater: Renamed. It takes the name on its first deploy.
savedRedeploy: Saved. It is being redeployed so the names answer.
savedNext: Saved. It takes the names on its next deploy, so its connections are not cut now.
savedLater: Saved. It takes the names on its first deploy.
aliasesHint: Extra names it answers to, for a client that expects a fixed one.
reachNone: No other service in this environment can call it yet.
reachLinks: Only services linked to it on the canvas can call it.
unreachableHint: Private names work between services on the same server. {services} cannot call it by name.
sharedEnvironment: Services of other projects on this server can also reach it by its container name. <link>Give this environment its own network</link>.
projectsHint: Closed by default. Allow one service of another project on this server to call it by name.
linkOtherServer: On another server, so the link does not connect them.
allowNone: No service of your other projects runs on this server.
tooManyAliases: A service can have up to {max} other names.
failed: That could not be saved. Try again.
loadFailed: The private network could not be loaded.

problems.tooLong: A name can be up to 63 characters.
problems.characters: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
problems.edges: A name cannot start or end with a hyphen.
problems.letter: A name needs at least one letter.

linkRefused.missing: That service is no longer there.
linkRefused.sameProject: Both services are in this project: they already reach each other by name.
linkRefused.otherServer: The two services run on different servers, which private names cannot cross.
linkRefused.unreachable: Their server did not answer, so the link is still open. Try again once it is online.
